script: if (window.frappe && root_element) { frappe.call({ method: 'bokengi_erp.api.get_poles_cockpit_summary', callback: function(r) { if (r.message && Array.isArray(r.message)) { r.message.forEach(function(p) { var pid = p.id.replace('POL-', ''); var elProj = root_element.querySelector('#metric-proj-' + pid); if (elProj && p.metrics) elProj.textContent = p.metrics.active_projects || '0'; var elLead = root_element.querySelector('#metric-lead-' + pid); if (elLead && p.metrics) elLead.textContent = p.metrics.open_leads || '0'; }); } } }); }
style: .bokengi-hub-wrapper { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; margin: 16px 0 24px 0; } .bokengi-hub-header { margin-bottom: 16px; } .bokengi-hub-badge { display: inline-block; background: rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.12); color: #64FFDA; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.25); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; } .bokengi-hub-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #FFFFFF; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .bokengi-hub-subtitle { margin: 4px 0 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: #8892B0; } .bokengi-poles-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 14px; } @media (max-width: 1200px) { .bokengi-poles-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } } @media (max-width: 768px) { .bokengi-poles-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .bokengi-poles-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } .bokengi-pole-card { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #112240 0%, #0c1c36 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.15); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .bokengi-pole-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 15px rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.1); } .pole-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .pole-icon-wrapper { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); } .pole-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 2px; } .pole-badge.it, .pole-badge.digital, .pole-badge.consulting { background: rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.15); color: #64FFDA; border: 1px solid rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.3); } .pole-badge.business, .pole-badge.events { background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.15); color: #F5A623; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.3); } .pole-title { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #E6F1FF; line-height: 1.2; } .pole-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #8892B0; margin: 0 0 12px 0; line-height: 1.35; min-height: 30px; } .pole-metrics { background: rgba(10, 25, 47, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; } .pole-metric-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .metric-label { font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #6272A4; font-weight: 600; } .metric-val { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: #64FFDA; } .metric-status-badge { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; } .metric-status-badge.live { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: #34D399; border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3); } .pole-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .pole-btn { display: block; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none !important; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .pole-btn.primary { background: rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.12); color: #64FFDA !important; border: 1px solid rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.3); } .pole-btn.primary:hover { background: #64FFDA; color: #0A192F !important; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(100, 255, 218, 0.4); } .pole-btn.secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); color: #CCD6F6 !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .pole-btn.secondary:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #FFFFFF !important; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }
